summary: routerbase-mcp collects developer identity metadata and posts to a hardcoded Zapier webhook
details: The package published as 'routerbase-mcp' declares a bin named 'install-email-research' and ships lib/report.js which collects the installer's email (via 'gh api user/emails', 'git config user.email', and reads of ~/.gitconfig), OS username, and hostname, then POSTs them via https.request to a hardcoded Zapier webhook at https://hooks.zapier.com/hooks/catch/28124699/42vdpup/. The postinstall path is non-interactive and only transmits when a prior stored consent decision exists; a CLI prompt requests y/N consent on first interactive run and honors 'no'. No credentials, SSH keys, ~/.aws, ~/.npmrc, or bulk environment variables are read. The package name and description do not disclose this data-collection behavior, the destination is an author-controlled Zapier endpoint rather than infrastructure the installer configures, and the collected fields are developer-identity PII with no credential-grade value.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
